//: Values the firmware and the site both carry. Change one here, then run npm run gen:shared in web/. It writes firmware/patternflow/src/core_shared.h and web/src/lib/shared/constants.ts, and check:shared fails while either is stale.

panel.//: The geometries PANEL_GEOMETRY picks from in config.h. Two 64x64 modules in a chain make the same 128x64 canvas as one 128x64 module.

knobs.//: The PEC11R-4220F-S0024 has 24 detents a turn. Two turns cross a parameter's whole range, so 48 detents do.

encoder.//: Quadrature edges in one detent. A press held past LONG_PRESS_MS is a long press, and button edges closer than BUTTON_DEBOUNCE_MS are ignored.

bus.//: The absolute bus speaks integers 0 to BUS_MAX. A pattern that reads only knob deltas gets one click for every BUS_UNITS_PER_CLICK a held channel moves.
